View code-behind contains no business logic — only the DI ctor and InitializeComponent.

comments.note: No security findings — all OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed; no Critical or High issues identified. DatabaseConnectorViewModel is pure MVVM orchestration code: no SQL, no credential handling, no deserialization. XAML data binding (TextBlock to DisplayName/Host) presents no injection surface. Command CanExecute guards prevent operations without selection. DatabaseConnectionOptions.Password is not exposed in the view's AXAML template or in any view-model method — password field is invisible at this layer. Password storage security is the responsibility of the IDatabaseConnectionStore implementation (WP-010).

comments.note: DatabaseConnectorViewModel takes a direct dependency on the concrete ShellViewModel rather than an interface abstraction. This is a pragmatic choice given ShellViewModel is the root aggregate and is sealed, but it forces tests to construct a full ShellViewModel with fakes (FakeBootstrapper, FakePasswordService). If the view-model landscape grows, consider extracting an IConnectable or IShellNavigator interface for the ConnectAsync delegation. Not a blocker for the current scope.
